title: Repair locale-dependent reads in test_research_current_status (no new kappa)
head: 84ca53150d99215bdbe6ca33107bc0c17708ea3e
body:
## Scope

**No kappa, no certificate change.** One reproducible environment failure repaired: on a native Windows cp1252 host (the Git-for-Windows default), the documented check

```text
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
```

fails with three errors when `PYTHONUTF8` is not set, all from one root cause: `tests/test_research_current_status.py` reads `docs/research/current-status.md` with the locale codec, and that document contains byte `0x9d` (in U+201D), which is undefined in cp1252.

- **Card:** `verifier-engineering` / `portable-replay` (scope key `831cc1a3c8f9ff01b197`, chooser OS nonce `c7669648496a57422bfa478f1d356cad`, priority revision 3), scope **refined** to this one failure. Base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`.
- **Claim:** https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18922733
- **Files changed:** `tests/test_research_current_status.py` (explicit `encoding="utf-8"` on its two reads, plus two regression tests) and the new package `research/test-suite-locale-reads/` (README with the task card, `TASK.json`, `SOURCES.json`, `VERIFY.json`, `verify.py`). Nothing else; `upstream/`, frozen pins, certificates and the selected record are untouched.

## Evidence

Windows 11, cp1252, Git 2.55.0.windows.5 (`core.autocrlf=true`), CPython 3.13.15 and 3.12.

Before (base `0b1cccf8`, no `PYTHONUTF8`):

```text
ERROR: test_current_section_matches_selected_record ... setUp
  File "tests/test_research_current_status.py", line 26, in setUp
    self.text = STATUS.read_text()
UnicodeDecodeError: 'charmap' codec can't decode byte 0x9d in position 1014
Ran 42 tests in 13.787s — FAILED (errors=3, skipped=2)
```

The same command with `PYTHONUTF8=1`, and everything under Python 3.12, passed at base.

After (this branch):

```text
python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'   # no PYTHONUTF8, 3.13.15
Ran 44 tests in 14.672s — OK (skipped=2)
python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
Ran 44 tests in 16.541s — OK
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/test-suite-locale-reads
CHECK Locale-independence ...
PASS_TEST_SUITE_LOCALE_READS legacy-locale reads repaired in tests/test_research_current_status.py
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/test-suite-locale-reads outcome=completed
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/test-suite-locale-reads --check-only
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
```

**Regression tests** (in the repaired module, following `test_research_onboarding.TextEncodingTests`: "a UTF-8 CI host cannot observe locale-codec bugs, so check the calls statically"): an AST guard requiring `encoding=` on every text read/write in the module, and a load-bearing control asserting the document contains `e2 80 9d` and is undecodable as cp1252 (deterministic on every host).

**Failure controls** (both executed in this session): the static guard applied to the base-commit module reports missing `encoding=` at exactly lines 10 and 26; a bare `read_text()` of the document in a `PYTHONUTF8=0` child fails with the same `UnicodeDecodeError`. The registered replay reruns everything with a forced legacy codec (cp1252 on Windows; `PYTHONUTF8=0 PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE=0 LC_ALL=C` elsewhere).

**Killed first candidate (obstruction recorded).** The historical Windows failures cited in many PR bodies (autocrlf temp-fixture pin mismatch in `test_research_onboarding.PackageTests`, POSIX-only `os.killpg`, cp1252 metadata reads in `research_package.py`/`find_overlap.py`) no longer reproduce at base: `test_research_onboarding` runs green natively (Python 3.13.15: 18 tests, 2 environment-gated skips; Python 3.12: all 18 pass, `core.autocrlf=true`), including the Python 3.12-only replay-environment tests. Those repairs are credited below; what remained was the suite's own document readers, which the merged static guard (five named scripts) does not cover.

## Limitations (not checked)

- No mathematics: no kappa, certificate, frozen-pin, `upstream/` or cold-replay change. The card's acceptance gate (preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content) is untouched: no comparison logic changed.
- The roughly 100 remaining locale-dependent text calls in `tests/` and the one-off `scripts/` generators were inventoried (1,536 repo files carry non-ASCII bytes, mostly under `research/`) but not swept. Structured next questions are in `research/test-suite-locale-reads/TASK.json`.
- The registered replay forces the legacy codec only for the repaired module; whole-suite behavior under a true POSIX ASCII locale is unmeasured. macOS and Linux hosts were not executed in this session.
- `SOURCES.json` pins `tests/test_research_current_status.py` at its **base-commit** bytes as provenance (the defective version this PR repairs); it cannot be a live input under the pin contract because this contribution changes it. `docs/research/current-status.md` is the live input and matches its pin exactly.

## Overlap

Refreshed before submission (2026-10-14 11:34Z, complete pagination: 492 open PRs, 478 discussions): no matches for the refined object terms (`test_research_current_status` locale, cp1252 `UnicodeDecodeError` suite). Nearest work, none conflicting: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1702 (CP1252 overlap-regression self-containment in `test_research_onboarding.py`, different file and object). The card's gzip/canonical-payload variation is under active concurrent work (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1559, https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1824) and was deliberately not duplicated.

## Credit

Aaron Wang, with help from opencode. Predecessor credit: the merged #1299/#1293-rgb Windows encoding line (UTF-8 metadata and pipe handling, child-tree timeout fallback, cp1252 simulations and the `TextEncodingTests` static-guard pattern, summarized in `research/community-efficient400-audit`); the failure report and environment details in https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200#discussioncomment-18910079, which identified the same byte in `research_package.py`; and the upstream authors of `tests/test_research_current_status.py` itself. This PR adds the instance that guard missed, a regression in the module that failed, and a replayable legacy-locale check.

Remaining obligations: the two structured open questions in `research/test-suite-locale-reads/TASK.json` (a `tests/` encoding sweep, and a whole-suite POSIX ASCII-locale guarantee). Optional workflow feedback: the useful improvement here would be for the `TextEncodingTests` static guard to cover `tests/` document readers as well as the five onboarding scripts, since that gap is exactly how this failure survived the previous fix.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
